title: Bare-metal EFI registry seeding and distro-granular OCI indexer with safe rollforward upgrades
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Customers deploying on bare-metal and EFI-only nodes reported intermittent failures during initial local OCI registry seeding and node preflight in air-gapped sites. This PR introduces a focused end-to-end implementation: 1) a small, deterministic OCI vendor indexer that produces per-distro granular manifests (so installations only pull necessary artifacts for a given distro/arch), 2) a registry-seed job that supports EFI-only boot paths and ensures images required by kubelet and the runtime are pre-provisioned, and 3) a safer upgrade model that favors atomic rollforward deltas and a promotion hook instead of in-place rollbacks to reduce boot-time drift in constrained environments. Changes are implemented across Terraform modules (registry mirror + seeding IAM/ACLs), Helm charts (chart hooks and tolerations for bare-metal init jobs), and the installer preflight/upgrade orchestration. Checklist: - [x] Add per-distro OCI indexing and lockfile generation - [x] Terraform: new module registry-mirror/v1 with OCI seed job IAM and minimal subnet examples - [x] Helm: offline-seed job as Job + pre-install hook with hostPath for EFI artifacts, affinity rules for bare-metal - [x] Installer: preflight verifies EFI bootloader artifacts and pin TLS cert thumbprints for registry seeds - [x] Tests: e2e on kubeadm (bare-metal lab) and k3s single-node air-gapped simulate. Backwards compatibility: indexer emits an OCI lockfile compatible with our existing sealed-bundle seeding flow; the Terraform module is additive and guarded behind a feature flag. Rollforward strategy: instead of attempting a full rollback in air-gapped sites where image churn is constrained, the promote hook applies an atomic delta bundle with explicit retention rules; operators can still trigger a manual rollback but the default path minimizes partial-state failure. Related: references PR #427501 (seed minimal vendor), #51203 (signed bundles) and design doc ENG-6890-oci-indexing (internal).

notes_on_testing: Kubeadm bare-metal lab: seeded local OCI mirror via registry-mirror module, validated kubelet pulled vendor images from mirror without internet access.
K3s airgap simulation: single-node install with minimal lockfile validated drift-free promotion behavior across 2 upgrades.
Cross-arch: indexer exercised for amd64 and aarch64 lockfile outputs; small delta observed for initramfs artifacts and handled by manifest filter.
release_notes: Adds distro-granular OCI indexer and a registry-mirror Terraform module to support EFI-only bare-metal seeding; Helm chart adds offline-seed job and installer preflight includes EFI artifact checks and TLS thumbprint pinning. Upgrade model updated to prefer atomic rollforward promotion for air-gapped sites.
additional_context: Design rationale: we observed multiple partial-install failures where installers attempted to download unnecessary initramfs/kernel variants; the new indexer narrows the set to distro+arch+kernel flavor which reduces mirror size and speeds seeding. The rollforward approach reduces manual rollback churn for operators in disconnected environments. Operational playbook and runbook snippets added to docs/installer/offline-seeding.md.
